title: Bringing Tom DeLonge and Lue Elizondo to the Zanesville metal

tellings.quote: I took Tom Dong and Lou Alzando to Zanesville or to to Pennsylvania or Ohio.

plain: In 2017, Chris Bledsoe took the musician Tom DeLonge and a former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo to see what the story calls the Zanesville metal, material tied to a claimed recovery of a downed unknown craft, though he is unsure whether the place was in Pennsylvania or Ohio. Bledsoe, who says UFOs are drawn to him, tells Michels this as something he did, and also names Hal Puthoff and Timothy Taylor in the account.
